subtitle: Preventive maintenance that needs doing, truck by truck
kmNow: The odometer has reached the due point
neverDoneHint: No record of when this was last done — record it so the due date can be worked out
unknownHint: No odometer reading for this truck — the due point cannot be told until one is entered
kmClockStopped: Last time was recorded without an odometer — the km count cannot run; only the date is followed
baselineHint: Enter the real date it was last done — not today's — so the next due date comes out right.
baselineDateFuture: That date is in the future — choose today or earlier
baselineKmHint: This job is counted in km — without the odometer at that time the count cannot start.
baselineKmHintNow: This job is counted in km — without the odometer at that time the count cannot start. The truck's odometer now: {{km}}.
baselineNoKmWarn: No odometer entered: the km count for this job cannot start, and it stays “never recorded” on the km side.
baselineKmAboveWarn: The odometer you typed is above the truck's current reading ({{km}}) — check the number.
baselineSaved: Recorded — the next due date has been worked out
empty: No preventive maintenance is tracked yet. Each truck needs a maintenance class, and the class needs plans (in Settings).
noPlateMatch: No truck on the board matches “{{q}}”
nothingNeeded: Nothing needs attention right now — all maintenance is on schedule
truckSeeAll: All of this truck's maintenance items ({{n}})
unclassifiedBody: These trucks are not tracked and do not appear on this board. Tap a plate and choose its maintenance class.
